inputs.prompt: Create ONE 12.2-second edited sequence with four DISTINCT film shots in exact order; each shot fills the screen, never a grid. <Picture 1> is the opening composition and the sole visual authority: a hand-drawn Paris riverside street where Claire (dark wavy hair, hair clips, gray striped sweater, headphones around her neck, backpack) walks alone past a long green second-hand bookshop facade, looking down at the phone in her hand. <Picture 2> is the exact Claire character design for identity and clothing. Preserve the referenced hand-drawn 2D style, muted blue-green palette and stable proportions. SHOT 1, 0.0-2.0 seconds: fixed side-profile full-body shot, Claire walks alone along the same pavement in a consistent screen direction, shoulders slightly folded, phone held close to her body. CUT. SHOT 2, 2.0-4.5 seconds: close three-quarter face shot on the same street, background reduced to calm recognizable Paris color blocks; her gaze goes from downcast to the side, one small breath of hesitation, disappointment readable without tears. CUT. SHOT 3, 4.5-7.2 seconds: waist-up medium shot, same street and travel axis; Claire is mid-walk when an unseen piano phrase is heard for the first time; one foot stops, her upper body turns toward the sound, her head rises and her eyes focus toward the bookshop. CUT. SHOT 4, 7.2-12.2 seconds: medium-wide view of the same green bookshop exterior; Claire approaches the entrance from the established direction, pushes the existing door open once and steps inside, ending on the door motion and a glimpse of warm bookshelves through the opening. Clear hard editorial cuts, restrained emotion, no visible pianist. No dialogue audio, text, subtitles, invented characters, costume changes, face redesign, red hair, magic effects, photorealism, 3D, split screens, storyboard grid or extra fingers.
